project_type: React + Konva canvas application with Zustand stores and Supabase backend
build_system: Vite with vitest for testing, npm scripts
test_framework: vitest with @testing-library/react, jsdom environment, react-konva mocked in tests
verification_instructions: 1. Run vitest --run to confirm all tests pass. 2. Run vite build to confirm TypeScript compiles.
setup_instructions: node_modules already installed. Run NODE_OPTIONS='' npx vitest --run from /projects/sandbox/Bom/frontend
environment_constraints: COMMON_DEPENDENCIES network. NODE_OPTIONS must be cleared (set NODE_OPTIONS='') before running node/npx due to missing proxy-bootstrap.js. No Docker daemon. Supabase client mocked in tests via vi.mock('@/lib/supabase').
contribution_requirements: All new layers must: be controlled by layerVisibility from canvasStore (CanvasLayer enum slots already exist), NOT contain business logic (consume state only), convert from bottom-left origin (mm) to Konva top-left using wallHeight, be added to CanvasContainer in correct z-order.
key_patterns: Layers: functional components accepting wallHeight/wallWidth, using useCanvasStore selectors for visibility/zoom, returning null when !visible. Tests: vi.mock react-konva with simple div elements, vi.mock @/lib/supabase. History: module-level singleton with subscribers pattern. Stores: Zustand create() with state+actions, fromTable() for Supabase queries. Coordinates: screenY = wallHeight - zone.y_mm - zone.height_mm for top-left conversion.
directory_structure: frontend/src/canvas/ - CanvasContainer + layers/ + interactions/ + history/ + permissions/ + utils/ + __tests__/. frontend/src/stores/ - Zustand stores. frontend/src/types/ - TypeScript type definitions. frontend/src/components/ - UI panels (ZonePropertiesPanel, PublishWorkflow, SkuBrowser). frontend/src/lib/ - utilities (supabase, coordinates, autosave).
